description: Type definitions for alarm disposition actions in the SCADA system

items.label: Alarm Triggered
items.description: Alarm condition met, alarm event generated (supersedes legacy alarm_triggered)

items.label: Alarm Escalated
items.description: Alarm not handled in time, escalated to a higher level

items.label: Alarm Cleared
items.description: Alarm condition returned to normal, alarm auto-cleared

items.label: Shelve Expired
items.description: Alarm shelve period expired, notifications resumed

items.label: Notification Sent
items.description: Alarm notification (email/SMS/webhook etc.) has been sent

items.label: Popup Shown
items.description: Alarm popup window displayed on the frontend
